notes: Tirumala 2 — P12 Open Porch, Notched Home ICU & Connected Living. 40 ft N-S x 50 ft E-W northeast-corner plot in Tirumala Colony with East principal arrival, adjustable 6-inch lower car porch (provisional), 24x48 in warm white/cream marble-look vitrified flooring across house, veranda, raised east forecourt and passages, traditional Kota/paver car-porch finish, and modern charcoal-bronze glazing. G+1 revision: upper master above the ground master, office, guest bedroom, open terrace and gallery above double-height living. Ground dimensions retained. ICU entrance has hall-side wooden privacy doors with sliding glass directly behind them. User-approved Ivory/limestone/teak palette; tall picture glazing with sliding side vents.
